# blender-asset-discovery-planner

Purpose: Plan the asset acquisition strategy (procedural, library, generative, photogrammetry) for a Blender scene without installing or executing. Use after the brief, before scene planning.

Decide where the assets in a scene will come from before the scene planner commits to a layout. Asset acquisition decisions affect poly budget, web GLB size, licensing, and time-to-handoff. This skill produces a per-asset plan with explicit confidence labels and licensing notes — without installing tools, running Blender, or fetching anything.

Metadata: Category `asset-and-sourcing` | Role `asset-strategy-and-source-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- after the 3D brief is locked, before any scene plan
- when scene assets aren't trivially given (e.g. user says "shoe" but doesn't supply a shoe model)
- when poly budget / GLB size / brand-licensing constraints exist
- when planner needs to know upfront whether assets are procedural or external
- Trigger phrases: "what assets do we need", "where do the models come from", "asset plan before scene planning", "do we generate or import", "surface asset license risks before planning"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- the user supplied all assets in the brief (skip; route directly to planner) → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; skip; route directly to planner)
- runtime is already executing and assets are already in the scene → use `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`; route to evidence skill)
- the request is iteration on an existing scene (assets are already chosen) → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; assets are already chosen)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Structured 3D brief listing required hero subject, props, environment, and materials
- Required input `target_delivery_channel` (`string`): Target output surface driving geometry and texture fidelity requirements
- Optional input `existing_user_assets` (`array`): User-supplied CAD/FBX/OBJ/GLB files or brand texture sets
- Output contract: `asset_sourcing_matrix`, `procedural_vs_external_split`, `license_and_budget_risk_register` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. read the 8-slot brief from `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`
2. enumerate every asset class needed (subjects, props, environment, materials, HDRIs)
3. pick a strategy per asset class (procedural / library / generative / photogrammetry)
4. record license + confidence label per choice
5. hand off to scene planner

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: This skill does not download, generate, fetch, or install any asset. It does not run Blender, configure any MCP path, or touch the network. It produces a plain-language plan in markdown.
- fetching / downloading / installing assets
- running Blender or generative tools
- making the scene plan
- license adjudication beyond surfacing risk
